subject.title: fix(models): make nested modelPolicy wildcards match by segment boundary

question: Should upgrades with existing malformed `modelPolicy.allow` entries be migrated or explicitly diagnosed by Doctor before this PR makes validation fail?
rationale: The branch deliberately turns previously accepted configuration into validation errors, but the appropriate repair semantics can affect an operator's allowlist intent and require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Add Doctor-assisted migration
options.body: Keep strict canonical validation and add a focused Doctor diagnosis/fix plus upgrade coverage for invalid persisted policy entries.

options.title: Defer strict rejection
options.body: Land nested wildcard matching first and defer validation enforcement until maintainers define a safe migration path.

recommendation.title: Add Doctor-assisted migration
recommendation.body: Keep strict canonical validation and add a focused Doctor diagnosis/fix plus upgrade coverage for invalid persisted policy entries.
